title: Rhapsodie
identity: Pierre Vellones’s Rapsodie Op.92 was originally scored for alto saxophone, harp, celesta and percussion. Marcel Mule made a reduction for alto saxophone and piano, published by Henry Lemoine in 1947. The BnF catalog indexes an ensemble recording at 5:02, but the performance version and exact relation to piano reduction require checking.

evidence.claim: Identifies original ensemble scoring and Marcel Mule alto sax/piano reduction, Lemoine 1947, 8-page score and part.
Indexes Rapsodie Op.92 recording at 5:02 and original sax/harp/celesta/percussion instrumentation.

review_focus: Review how the piano reduction preserves or alters the original coloristic exchanges with harp, celesta and percussion.
collection_flag: Documented orchestration reduction from four-part ensemble to saxophone/piano.
